title: Let the scheme die before it runs you
summary: Ego loosens when faith in the Guru outlives frantic schemes. Treat ego as illness, not identity.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: When you start planning six moves ahead to protect your image, stop with the breath high in the chest. Release one unnecessary maneuver and return to the truer task.

source.shortMeaning: Ego loosens when faith in the Guru outlives frantic schemes.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next self-saving plan, release one scheme and stand in the Guru's care.

evidence.coreClaim: Ego loosens when faith in the Guru outlives frantic schemes.
evidence.turn: Let ego and scheming fall so fear can leave with them.
evidence.practicalImplication: When you start planning six moves ahead to protect your image, stop with the breath high in the chest. Release one unnecessary maneuver and return to the truer task.
